name: Surrealism Web
summary: Impossible scenes with plain, calm rendering: floating objects, odd scale, melting forms, clouds in rooms and shadows that disagree. Logic bends while the interface stays usable.

philosophy.core_thesis: Put the impossible on a quiet page: strange images, clear controls.
design_principles: Build each hero from one impossible scene: an object at the wrong scale, a floating form or a landscape in a room.
Render with soft, even light, long shadows (a 25° to 45° angle) and calm, clean edges; the strange part is what is shown, not how.
Use a dream palette: a pale sky (#BFD8EA), a warm sand (#E9D3B4), a deep blue (#1B2A55) and one red or orange accent (#E4572E).
Break scale and place on purpose: a hand 2x larger than a house, a door in a field, an eye in a cloud.
Keep UI plain on top of the scene: a sans at 16px, a 4.5:1 text contrast and buttons of 44px height.
Let one element break the grid by 40px to 160px, and add 1 shadow that points the wrong way.
Move slowly and drift: objects float 8px to 20px up and down over 4s to 8s; page change fades in 600ms to 900ms.
anti_patterns: Many unrelated objects in one scene
Strange UI that hides the main action
Random distortion with no idea behind it

layout.grid_mechanics: A full-bleed scene with a quiet UI layer; 6 to 12 columns; text sits in clear sky or on a calm panel; blocks may drift off the grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 55% of the surface is open sky or empty field; gaps are 24px to 96px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred or left-flush text over calm areas; objects placed with odd scale and an impossible horizon.
layout.container_geometry: Soft rounded panels of 16px to 24px; circles and arches; windows and doors as frames.

font_pairings.note: A soft serif headline with a plain, calm sans.
A warm, odd serif with a neutral sans.
A wide, odd display with a quiet sans.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 to 600 for display and 400 for body.
Set headlines in sentence case over calm areas of the scene.

color.palette_structure: Dream sky, warm sand and deep blue with one red accent.
color.contrast_rules: Night on sky holds 12:1; white on vermilion holds 5.4:1; keep text out of busy parts of the scene.
color.surface_treatment: Soft gradients from sky to sand; calm, matt rendering; a faint grain of 4% at most.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft light from one side; long, clean shadows that may disagree with the object.

materiality.surface_simulation: Smooth, matt, painted-looking surfaces rendered with calm light.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px line at 20% in blue or none; arches and windows as frames.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A soft shadow of 0 24px 60px at 12% in blue; no blur on text.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Plain 1.5px outline icons; eyes, hands, keys, doors and clouds as small marks.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rendered or painted scenes: floating rocks, giant fruit, doors in fields, clouds in rooms, melting clocks in the style of a painter's dream.

motion.transition_physics: Dreamlike: objects float and drift slowly; layers shift 8px to 24px with scroll; no snap or bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts an object 6px and tilts it 2° in 400ms; active state settles in 200ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels wonder and quiet unease, then curiosity.

avoid_when: The page is a bank, a clinic or a tool where doubt costs trust.
The content is a dense data tool.
The audience needs a direct, literal message.

modifiers.how: Keep one impossible object on a plain ground and remove the rest.
Add pink and teal gradients and marble busts.
Add pastel haze and light serifs.

pack.why: A friendly outline family that stays plain over strange scenes.

ground.why: Surrealist painting puts calm clouds in a clear sky over a flat horizon.
